info.title: KaushalDrishti API
info.description: AI-enabled Labour Market Intelligence System (LMIS) for MSDE. Provides district-level labour demand indices, supply forecasts, gap analysis, early warnings, and policy scenario simulation.

get.description:
Health check endpoint.
Returns service status, version, and uptime.

System metadata: sources, freshness, pilot scope, data_mode counts.
Populated as data layers come online.

Returns Labour Demand Index (LDI) records with credible intervals,
confidence badges, driver descriptors, and data_mode indicators.

get.description:
Exact source attribution for the Why Panel.
Explains LDI drivers, exact Kalman source contributions, and data lineage.

Retrieve probabilistic demand forecasts across horizons.
Includes point estimates, 80% credible bounds (q10, q90), fallback level, and data_mode badge.

Returns rolling-origin backtest validation metrics, comparing all models across
horizons (3m, 6m, 12m), pinball loss, empirical coverage (80% and 95%), and calibration.

Returns supply forecast draws and intervals for cohorts graduating in window [t, t+W).
Strictly reports basis as capacity_based, certified, or certified_plus_other.

Query probabilistic demand-supply gaps.

Retrieve early warning alerts with hysteresis state and persistence history.

get.description:
Produces two prioritized lists:
  1. Top Emerging / Acute Shortages (ranked by severity & expected gap)
  2. Top Saturation Risks (ranked by severity & expected oversupply)

Deterministic explainability endpoint producing full policy narratives

post.description:
Simulate a policy intervention (e.g. +15% seat allocation, new centre, completion bump).
Returns monthly baseline vs intervention time-series and identifies the gap closure cycle.
